blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebu province is reorganizing its economic development efforts through a new department that will handle investment promotion and help local enterprises expand. Gov. Pamela Baricuatro signed Ordinance No. 2026-17 on November 11, establishing the Cebu Provincial Investment and Economic Office (CPIEO) to coordinate investment initiatives and support business development across the province. The measure seeks to attract more investors, create employment opportunities, and encourage sustainable and inclusive economic growth.
